scope: Separate independent semantic review of the complete proposed inner P profile after own frozen D review. No other D result files or P reviewer result files were opened; the Root task request indicated prior checking but that indication was not used as semantic authority.

checks.bilingualEquivalence: PASS: German and English preserve separation, marker inference, matched-model assumptions, approximate lengths, interval and sequence limits.
checks.separationPrinciple: PASS: negatively charged linear DNA migrates toward the positive electrode; shorter linear fragments travel farther in the supplied gel under comparable conditions.
checks.caseOne: PASS: supplied marker assignments give approximately 1000 bp and 500 bp. Explaining the common model and relating the sample bands to its marker independently tests both expectations.
checks.caseTwoInterval: PASS: 39 mm lies strictly between the 600 bp marker at 30 mm and the 300 bp marker at 48 mm. Monotonic length-dependent migration therefore supports 300 < fragment length < 600 bp, expressed at this pedagogical level as an interval between 300 and 600 bp. No exact size is entailed. The profile correctly rejects exact or linear interpolation.
checks.caseTwoOtherBands: PASS: both PCR samples at 30 mm are approximately 600 bp; restriction bands at 16 and 30 mm correspond approximately to 1200 and 600 bp. Equal length is distinguished from unknown sequence identity.
checks.transfer: PASS: the changed marker requires renewed within-gel reference, the intermediate sample band requires an interval instead of matching a marker, and the cross-lane comparison requires limiting sequence claims. These are substantive changes to the inference rather than only substituted numbers.
checks.providedDataScope: PASS: PCR and restriction are supplied sample labels. Learners are not asked to perform, design or explain their preparation; no extra PCR prerequisite or laboratory competency is introduced. Organism identity, individual identity and disease are excluded as unsupported inferences rather than assessed as additional diagnostic competencies.
checks.minimumIndependentDemonstrations: PASS with its literal evidence interpretation: two independently produced demonstrations of the claimed understanding, including fresh transfer, may be provided within a single coherent multi-part task. The field does not create a quota of two separate task labels or authorize extra work after all required evidence is available.
checks.positiveEvidence: PASS: both cases demand learner-produced explanations and supported size/pattern conclusions; boundary statements supplement these positive performances and do not replace them.
checks.currentVisualRelationship: PASS: the book visualization teaches the qualitative principle and has no numeric marker labels. The profile supplies its own numeric marker data for assessment and does not derive quantitative lengths from that image.

nativePBindingStatus: PENDING_ROOT_NATIVE_BINDER; this independent semantic opinion does not claim final native schema/data binding.
